explanation: github-copilot supports specialist agents, but the declared tool names come from kiro and are not verified against this provider. The destination keeps the name "reviewer" of its kiro source. Provider-specific fields not written for github-copilot: kiro.resources (context).
Copilot applyTo represents the canonical include patterns directly. The destination keeps the name "api" of its kiro source.
On-demand context has no dedicated Copilot format; it is delivered as a prompt file that a developer invokes explicitly. The destination keeps the name "incident" of its kiro source.
Always-on context is written into the repository-wide instructions file.
Copilot supports agent skills natively. The destination keeps the name "audit" of its kiro source.
